key_iocs: jcoachj@gmail.com (attributed to Johnny Coach, Chem 109 student)
Threat text: 'you can't find us and you can't hide from us. Stop teaching. Start running.'

claims.claim: An explicit threatening/harassing message was sent to the victim
claims.rationale: Artifact content quotes the verbatim threat 'Stop teaching. Start running.'

claims.claim: An anonymizing self-destructing email service was used to send the harassment
claims.rationale: ART-001/002 cite willselfdestruct.com used to send anonymous threat email

claims.claim: The sending machine was attributed to a Gmail account via plaintext HTTP cookies in the pcap
claims.rationale: ART-002 states jcoachj@gmail.com identified via plaintext cookies

claims.claim: The Gmail account belongs to Johnny Coach, a Chemistry 109 student of the victim
claims.rationale: Attribution links account to a named student/roster, but pcap establishes the device not the human typing

claims.claim: The harassment originated from inside the dormitory network behind NAT
claims.rationale: Internal NAT IP 192.168.15.4 and dormitory external IP captured in flow

null_hypothesis_considered: The open password-less WiFi plus shared university Ethernet means an outsider or roommate could have used the connection/account, so the captured device may not identify the actual harasser; alternatively the messages could be a non-malicious prank.
verdict_rationale: Verbatim threatening messages sent via an anonymizing self-destruct service rule out any benign explanation; the intent is unambiguously malicious harassment even though individual human attribution is only inferred.
